comment: QUESTS.md C4, WRE-1 The Monograph. With Wren at the inch-wide gap: the Library's rules - eleven type specimens, three Fellows, a list of subscribers. The specimens are tracks on the world map, fights she objects to, measured not killed (two fought here, nine by script); the reviewers are Rowbotham's students Mott and Furze and the Honorary Fellow on its pond; the list is a shop with names in it. Publication: Change Class to Cataloguer (Published), experience kept, which adds cancel-surprise and raise-preemptive to her double drops.
